src.label: USDA APHIS — pet travel from the United States to Morocco (relaying Moroccan rules)

head: Morocco's certificate is time-boxed: five business days to issue, three days to endorse, a final check within 24 hours.
lines: The US agriculture department page on Moroccan entry says the pet must be identified by microchip or tattoo before its rabies vaccination, and that a four-page health certificate is used.

Pages 1 to 3 are issued within five business days of travel and endorsed within three calendar days; the pet is then re-examined by the issuing vet within 24 hours of departure, recorded on page 4, which needs no endorsement.
The certificate is valid for only three calendar days after endorsement. This is a US-side relay, so confirm with the Moroccan authority.
